basis: Public safety ROM per OEM and frequency, Sugar House building model, the same pmf machinery as the cellular comparison. Coverage by the NFPA two-tier preset (95 percent floor area / 99 percent critical area at -95 dBm at the portable, per IFC 510.4.1 and NFPA 1225 18.8-18.9 as carried in PS_CODE_TABLE). Port powers from the vendor sheets: FiRe-78 33 dBm PS700/800 DL per remote (30 dBm composite for the B14 run), Westell CS45 34 dBm per band, Comba V3 33 dBm per band, PSR-VU-9537 28 dBm VHF / 37 dBm UHF. Design by the same N-advance rule (N = 3 antennas per floor). Config estimates (grade E). Assumptions: the -95 dBm threshold at the portable is the IFC 2015/2021 ERCES figure used as the design input (the 2024 IFC and NFPA 1225 use DAQ 3.0 without a dBm value); the critical-area tier applies where the fire code official designates it; the site receiver link budget is an AHJ input per 510.4.2.2 and is outside these DL numbers; battery autonomy 12 h per NFPA 1225 18.13.2 / IFC 510.4.2.3 with the 24 h option available. No prices.
